capabilities: Connect to an Acaia Pearl S scale over Bluetooth for live weight
Guide brew sessions through a 5-step flow with filter and espresso modes
Record weight-over-time brew profile charts with flow rate readout
Track bean inventory, brew history, and equipment in vault files
Download a checksum-verified native Bluetooth addon on demand
extras: BLE and the brewing sidebar are Windows desktop-only; inventory, history, and daily records also work on mobile. The plugin works offline except for one user-triggered, checksum-verified download of the Bluetooth addon from its own GitHub releases. Full documentation lives in the plugin wiki, not the README.
problem: Obsidian has no way to connect a brewing scale or record coffee brewing sessions, profiles, and bean inventory inside the vault.
summary: Coffee brewing assistant with real-time Acaia Pearl S BLE scale integration, a guided brew flow, bean inventory, equipment registry, and brew history in vault files.
